title: Every self-hosted CI job starts from a fresh tree, its own TMPDIR and its own database, warmed from the published snapshot

story.as_a: CI job on any fleet-ci host
story.i_want_to: start from a clean tree, a temp dir and a test database made for me alone, and get warm build state only from the read-only snapshot
story.so_that: nothing a killed or earlier job left behind can change my result, and I am still as fast as a warm slot

rationale: Mark on R8: 'I'm surprised it's not the case yet. That was the idea from the very beginning!' Today loopctl's self-hosted jobs keep _build and deps between jobs on purpose (ci.yml:89-131, `clean: false` at :148 and a `git clean -e /_build -e /deps` at :171), because Mix keys its manifest on the source path and a slot's own path is the only place a tree stays warm (KB 09245ceb). That kept state is what a killed job poisons: a stale Mix build lock hung chg's jobs for 600 s (chg#119). KB 09245ceb names the remedy for state shared across runners, a job container mounting every tree at one path, and holds it in reserve 'only if cross-runner sharing becomes necessary'; R8 makes it necessary. US-52.56 and US-52.57 give the snapshot it is warmed from.

acceptance_criteria.description: Every job in .github/workflows/ci.yml whose runs-on includes self-hosted (lint, test, retrieval-eval, security, dialyzer, scale-test, scale-nightly, and the snapshot job of AC-52.58.6) declares `container:` with image `ghcr.io/mkreyman/loopctl-ci@sha256:<digest>` and options containing `--network host`, so its tree is mounted at /__w/loopctl/loopctl on every host.

No job in ci.yml sets `clean: false` on actions/checkout or runs a `git clean` that excepts /_build or /deps, and no actions/cache step lists _build, deps or priv/plts; the KEEPING THE COMPILED TREE header and the per-runner-name PLT cache step are gone.
Every self-hosted job sets TMPDIR to ${{ runner.temp }} in its job-level env, so Mix's lock files and every temp file live in the per-job temp dir the runner empties at each job start.

Every job that creates a test database sets MIX_TEST_PARTITION to `_ci_${{ github.run_id }}_${{ github.run_attempt }}_${{ github.job }}` (scale-nightly keeps its per-matrix-file suffix after that prefix) and ends with an `if: always()` step that drops `loopctl_test${MIX_TEST_PARTITION}`; the name matches infra-ci-db-reap's `_ci_` filter, which stays as the backstop for a killed job.

Every Elixir job runs a step `Warm from snapshot` before its first mix compile: `chg snapshot fetch . HEAD` then `chg ws hydrate .`, with timeout-minutes 5; exit 3 or a timeout prints `snapshot: miss` and the job continues cold, and any other non-zero exit fails the step.

A `snapshot` job runs only on a push to master, after test passes, in environment snapshot-publish (deployment branches: master only, holding LOOPCTL_ORCH_KEY); it runs `chg snapshot build --here HEAD` then `chg snapshot push . HEAD`. A pull_request event never runs it.

The image is built from ci/image/Dockerfile: FROM the hexpm/elixir image at ci.yml's ELIXIR_VERSION and OTP_VERSION, plus git, curl, zstd, tar, postgresql-client and the chg CLI at the version release/manifest.toml names; its FROM tag and chg version must equal those two files' values.

When the warm step reports behind 0 (the snapshot is HEAD's), the Test job's compile step fails the job if mix prints a `Compiling` line for project modules: a snapshot that recompiles at its own path is a defect to fix, not a slow run to accept.

test_cases.name: guard: every self-hosted job runs in the pinned container with a per-job TMPDIR (ExUnit over the parsed workflow)
preconditions: test/loopctl/ci_fresh_job_test.exs parsing .github/workflows/ci.yml with YamlElixir (a dependency in mix.exs), where Loopctl.CiWarningsAsErrorsTest reads it by regex (test/loopctl/ci_warnings_as_errors_test.exs:46,91)
steps: for each job whose runs-on contains self-hosted, read container.image, container.options and env.TMPDIR
expected_results: image matches ~r/@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$/, options contain --network host, TMPDIR is ${{ runner.temp }}

test_cases.name: guard: no kept tree and no cached build output
steps: scan every checkout step's with.clean, every run script for `git clean`, every actions/cache step's path
expected_results: no clean: false, no -e /_build or -e /deps, no _build, deps or priv/plts path

test_cases.name: guard: per-job database name and its always-drop
steps: for each job running mix ecto.create or mix test, read env.MIX_TEST_PARTITION and the steps with if: always()
expected_results: the partition contains run_id, run_attempt and github.job; a dropdb step names loopctl_test${MIX_TEST_PARTITION}

test_cases.name: guard: warm step precedes compile and treats exit 3 as a miss
steps: find each Elixir job's first step running mix compile or mix test and the step before it
read the Test job's compile step script
expected_results: a step named Warm from snapshot comes first, has timeout-minutes 5 and maps exit 3 to `snapshot: miss`; the compile script greps for Compiling when behind is 0

test_cases.name: guard: the snapshot job publishes from master only
steps: read jobs.snapshot.if, needs, environment and run steps
expected_results: if requires push and refs/heads/master; needs includes test; environment snapshot-publish; build --here precedes push

test_cases.name: guard: the image's toolchain and chg match the workflow and the manifest
steps: parse the FROM tag and the chg version the Dockerfile installs
expected_results: Elixir and OTP equal ELIXIR_VERSION and OTP_VERSION; chg equals the manifest's chg CLI version

technical_notes: Self-hosted jobs today: lint .github/workflows/ci.yml:134, test :304, retrieval-eval :514, security :745, dialyzer :835, scale-test :930, scale-nightly :1273. pgbouncer-e2e, smoke-preflight, deploy and smoke are ubuntu-latest and stay out of scope (release 11 owns them).

Deleted, with their comments: the header at ci.yml:89-131, each job's `clean: false` (:148, :343 and the same in the other jobs) and its `Clean the workspace, keeping the compiled tree` step (ci.yml:151, :346, :549, :758, :848, :991, :1394), and the per-runner PLT cache at :909-915. The tailwind/esbuild binary cache (:262-282) stays: it is keyed by tool version and ref-scoped.

Database today: MIX_TEST_PARTITION ci<run_id> at ci.yml:329, TEST_DB_PORT and PGPORT 5433 at :332-336, created at :445, dropped if: always() at :507-512; scale-nightly's suffix at :1453. config/test.exs builds the name at :84 from the partition read at :74 and the port at :45, so no config change is needed.

TMPDIR: chg's own ci.yml already does this per job (/home/mkreyman/workspace/chg/.github/workflows/ci.yml:151-155, chg#119); infra's runbook pins a fixed TMPDIR for nuc's tmpfs (infra runbooks/ci-runner-setup.md:383-393), which RUNNER_TEMP under _work also avoids.

Snapshot contents come from .chg/adapter.toml:9 (deps, _build, priv/plts) and mix chg.snapshot (chg adapters/elixir/lib/mix/tasks/chg.snapshot.ex:112-126). Set DIALYZER_PLT_CORE_PATH=priv/plts in the snapshot job as the dialyzer job does (ci.yml:927), so the core PLT travels in the snapshot; the container fixes the OTP root, which makes it portable (KB 09245ceb, PLTs).
Check compile: mix.exs:20 already sets elixirc_options: [check_cwd: false] for chg; the container makes the path equal anyway.

Root-owned files: a container job's steps run as root inside the slot's _work. infra's job-completed hook hands _work back after every job (infra runbooks/ci-runner-setup.md:1240-1263); before this lands, confirm ACTIONS_RUNNER_HOOK_JOB_COMPLETED is in every fleet-ci slot's .env on beelink, minis, x1, ryzen and nuc. infra's provisioning has not moved into this repo yet (PRD R10).

Image publishing: a workflow on changes to ci/image/** builds and pushes ghcr.io/mkreyman/loopctl-ci with GITHUB_TOKEN (packages: write); ci.yml then pins the new digest in the same PR. The chg CLI comes from the release artifact release/manifest.toml names (provided by release 2, README names table: release manifest).
Guard tests follow Loopctl.CiWarningsAsErrorsTest (test/loopctl/ci_warnings_as_errors_test.exs), which binds ci.yml's test step (ci.yml:477).
non_goals: The end-to-end proof that a killed job leaves nothing behind: US-52.59.
Moving the ubuntu-latest jobs or authenticating installers for a private repo: release 11.
Runner registration and capacity reports by the host daemon: release 7.

failure_modes.partition: AC-52.58.5: when loopctl or the object store is unreachable the warm step reports a miss and the job builds cold, so CI keeps judging commits.
failure_modes.state: AC-52.58.2: no build output survives a job; warm state comes only from the read-only snapshot, and the check of record stays the GitHub Actions run.
failure_modes.retry: AC-52.58.4: a re-run gets its own database through run_attempt, so it never meets its first attempt's half-migrated one; a re-run of the snapshot job meets the store's if-none-match and publishes nothing twice.
failure_modes.slow: AC-52.58.5: the warm step is capped at 5 minutes and a timeout is a miss, so a slow store costs at most that before the cold build.
failure_modes.reach: AC-52.58.1: a job runs on whichever fleet-ci host takes it, at the same path in the same image, so its snapshot and its database name do not depend on the host.

definition_of_done: Three consecutive master runs land on at least two different fleet-ci hosts, each Test job logs a snapshot hit, and its compile step shows no Compiling line for project modules when behind is 0.
The Test job's median wall clock over those runs is no more than 10% above the median of the last ten master Test jobs before the change (gh run list); the PR body records both numbers.
SELECT datname FROM pg_database WHERE datname LIKE 'loopctl_test_ci_%' on beelink's CI Postgres (5433) shows no database of a finished run.
defaults: Image name ghcr.io/mkreyman/loopctl-ci, pinned by digest (owner may change).
Warm step timeout 5 minutes; speed budget 10% over the pre-change median.
GitHub environment snapshot-publish, deployment branches master only.
